title_en: Create and run your first component
title_zh: 创建并运行第一个组件
summary_en: Create a Python component, attach it to a GameObject, enter Play mode, and verify the lifecycle through the Console.
summary_zh: 创建 Python 组件，将它挂到 GameObject，进入 Play 模式，并通过 Console 验证生命周期。

summary_en: Understand the component model, lifecycle order, serialized fields, Inspector constraints, and scene references.
summary_zh: 理解组件模型、生命周期顺序、序列化字段、Inspector 约束与场景引用。

summary_en: Read keyboard and mouse state, use delta time correctly, and move an object without frame-rate-dependent behavior.
summary_zh: 读取键鼠状态，正确使用 delta time，并让物体移动不再依赖帧率。

title_zh: Prefab 与运行时对象生命周期
summary_en: Instantiate authored objects, choose parent and world-space behavior, keep references, and destroy instances safely.
summary_zh: 实例化已编辑好的对象，选择父级与世界空间语义，保存引用并安全销毁实例。

summary_en: Choose colliders and rigid bodies, place motion in fixed_update, and respond to collision and trigger phases.
summary_zh: 选择 Collider 与 Rigidbody，在 fixed_update 中处理物理运动，并响应碰撞和 Trigger 的各个阶段。

summary_en: Bind a UI button to a component method, update interface state, and move between authored scenes.
summary_zh: 把 UI Button 绑定到组件方法，更新界面状态，并在已编辑的场景之间切换。

summary_en: Drive AudioSource from gameplay state and keep one-off reactions separate from per-frame polling.
summary_zh: 根据游戏状态驱动 AudioSource，并把一次性反应与逐帧轮询分开组织。

summary_en: Compose timed behavior with generator coroutines, scaled and real time, fixed updates, predicates, cancellation, and nested waits.
summary_zh: 使用生成器协程组织定时行为，并掌握缩放时间、真实时间、固定更新、条件等待、取消与嵌套等待。
